description: This file defines functions and interfaces for creating and managing routing forms in a web application, including attribute-based routing, form configuration, and route handling logic.

classes.name: FieldConfig
classes.description: Configuration for form fields, including id, type, label, options, and selectText.

classes.name: RouteConfig
classes.description: Configuration for form routes, including action type, value, and optional fallback and query parameters.

classes.name: TeamEventConfig
classes.description: Configuration for team events in attribute routing, including title, slug, schedulingType, assignAllTeamMembers, length, and description.

classes.name: CreateRoutingFormConfig
classes.description: Main configuration object for creating routing forms, including userId, teamId, formType, form details, and attributeRouting details.

methods.name: createRoutingForm
methods.description: Creates a routing form based on provided configuration, supporting both default and attribute routing types, with hardcoded route and field setups.
